Class ChromaticEffects

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.api.ChromaticEffects
public class ChromaticEffects extends Object
Offers direct effect registration and lookup by resource identity.

These registrations share ChromaticDefinitions with character and named triggers. A direct effect has no text trigger of its own. Another effect, such as GradientEffect, can look it up to reuse its movement. Use registration receipts from ChromaticDefinitions when contributions need to be removed later.
